from collections import Counter
from typing import Optional

def most_frequent_char(s: str) -> Optional[str]:

    If several characters tie for the highest frequency,
    the first one encountered in the string is returned.

Course Overview

This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the world of computer science and programming. Designed for beginners with little or no prior coding experience, it aims to build a strong foundation in computational thinking, problem-solving, and the fundamental concepts that underlie all modern software development. By the end of the course, students will be able to think algorithmically, design simple programs, debug code, and understand the broader landscape of computing.

What You Will Learn

  • Computational Thinking: Break down complex problems into manageable steps, recognize patterns, and design logical solutions.
  • Programming Fundamentals: Master the core constructs of programming—variables, data types, control structures, functions, and basic data structures—using a beginner-friendly language such as Python.
  • Algorithm Design and Analysis: Learn to write algorithms, evaluate their efficiency, and understand concepts like Big-O notation.
  • Problem Solving and Debugging: Develop strategies for finding and fixing errors, testing code, and iterating on solutions.

Understand how programs store and manipulate data. Cover integers, floats, strings, booleans, and basic operations.
